# Photo Print: Size & Layout

> iPhone and iPad app for printing photos at exact physical sizes. Official App Store listing: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6808903369

## Product facts
- iOS / iPadOS 17 or later. AirPrint or PDF output.
- Photo sizes in inches, centimetres and millimetres. A4, US Letter and 4 × 6 paper.
- Photos that cannot fit are reported rather than shrunk.
- First completed output and three saved layouts included. Optional one-time Pro purchase for unlimited outputs, unlimited layouts and saved page setups. Regional price is shown in the app; no subscription.
- Photos stay on the device. Purchases use Apple / RevenueCat; the other-apps section can query Apple's catalogue.
- ID and passport sizing and a head-size guide; no official compliance verification or acceptance guarantee.

- Free printer test-sheet PDFs are available on the website. The in-app printer check is coming in 1.4.1, pending Apple review.
